AB428.17.label: Alberta age amount
AB428.17.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.abAgeAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.abAgeAmountThreshold) * param.abAgeAmountRate, 2)), 0)
AB428.17.source: Worksheet AB428, line 58080: for people born in 1960 or earlier

AB428.20.label: Alberta spouse or common-law partner amount

AB428.23.label: Alberta amount for an eligible dependant
AB428.23.source: AB428 lines 21 to 23. The app assumes the child had no income

AB428.42.label: Amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner
AB428.42.formula: if(line.HH.partner == 1 and household.partnerInYear and spouse.person.age >= 65, unsupported("Transferring your spouse's unused Alberta age amount (Schedule AB(S2)) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

AB428.49.label: Allowable medical expenses
AB428.49.source: AB428 lines 44 to 49: expenses over whichever is less, $2,884 or 3% of net income

AB428.52.label: Alberta credit amounts
AB428.52.formula: line.AB428.16 + line.AB428.17 + line.AB428.20 + line.AB428.23 + line.AB428.32 + line.AB428.42 + line.AB428.49

AB428.54.label: Alberta credit amounts at the credit rate

AB428.57.label: Alberta donations credit
AB428.57.source: AB428 lines 55 to 57: Schedule 9 lines 13 and 14 at 60% and 21%

AB428.74.label: Alberta supplemental tax credit
AB428.74.source: Worksheet AB428, line 61545: credit amounts (less unused tuition) at 8%, over $4,800, at 25%

BC428.8.label: British Columbia tax on taxable income

BC428.17.label: British Columbia age amount
BC428.17.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.bcAgeAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.bcAgeAmountThreshold) * param.bcAgeAmountRate, 2)), 0)
BC428.17.source: Worksheet BC428, line 58080: for people born in 1960 or earlier

BC428.20.label: British Columbia spouse or common-law partner amount

BC428.23.label: British Columbia amount for an eligible dependant
BC428.23.source: BC428 lines 21 to 23. The app assumes the child had no income

BC428.44.label: Amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner
BC428.44.formula: if(line.HH.partner == 1 and household.partnerInYear and spouse.person.age >= 65, unsupported("Transferring your spouse's unused British Columbia age amount (Schedule BC(S2)) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

BC428.51.label: Allowable medical expenses
BC428.51.source: BC428 lines 46 to 51: expenses over whichever is less, $2,689 or 3% of net income

BC428.54.label: British Columbia credit amounts
BC428.54.formula: line.BC428.16 + line.BC428.17 + line.BC428.20 + line.BC428.23 + line.BC428.33 + line.BC428.44 + line.BC428.51

BC428.56.label: British Columbia credit amounts at the credit rate

BC428.57.label: British Columbia donations credit
BC428.57.formula: round(min(line.S9.14, max(0, line.T1.26000 - param.bcDonationTopThreshold)) * param.bcDonationTopRate, 2) + round((line.S9.14 - min(line.S9.14, max(0, line.T1.26000 - param.bcDonationTopThreshold))) * param.bcDonationHighRate, 2) + round(line.S9.13 * param.bcDonationLowRate, 2)
BC428.57.source: Worksheet BC428, line 58969: the first $200 at 5.06%, the rest at 16.8%, or 20.5% up to taxable income over $259,829

BC428.79.label: British Columbia tax reduction
BC428.79.formula: if(line.T1.23600 >= param.bcTaxReductionLimit, 0, max(0, param.bcTaxReductionBasic - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.bcTaxReductionBase) * param.bcTaxReductionRate, 2)))
BC428.79.source: BC428 lines 73 to 79: $562, less 3.56% of net income over $25,020

HH.partner.label: Spouse or common-law partner on December 31 (1 for yes)

HH.spouseNetIncome.label: Your spouse's or partner's net income
HH.spouseNetIncome.source: From their return when both returns are prepared here; otherwise from your answer

T1.12000.label: Taxable amount of dividends (eligible and other than eligible)
T1.12000.source: Federal Worksheet, line 12000: boxes 11 and 25 of T5 slips, boxes 32 and 50 of T3 slips

T1.12010.label: Taxable amount of dividends other than eligible

T1.12100.label: Interest and other investment income
T1.12100.source: Federal Worksheet, line 12100: box 13 of T5 slips, box 25 of T3 slips

T1.12700.label: Taxable capital gains
T1.12700.source: Schedule 3. A net capital loss isn't entered here; it carries forward

T1.15000.label: Total income
T1.15000.formula: line.T1.10100 + line.T1.12000 + line.T1.12100 + line.T1.12700 + line.T1.13000 + line.SCOPE.income

SCOPE.income.label: Income this app doesn't handle
SCOPE.income.formula: if(answer.hasSelfEmployment, unsupported("Self-employment income (T2125) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0) + if(answer.hasRentalIncome, unsupported("Rental income (T776) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0) + if(answer.hasPensionIncome, unsupported("Pension income and government benefits aren't handled by this app yet"), 0) + if(answer.hasEiBenefits, unsupported("Employment insurance benefits (T4E) aren't handled by this app yet"), 0) + if(answer.hasForeignIncome, unsupported("Foreign income and foreign property (T1135) aren't handled by this app yet"), 0) + if(answer.soldProperty, unsupported("The sale of a home or other real estate isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

SCOPE.deductions.label: Deductions this app doesn't handle
SCOPE.deductions.formula: if(answer.hasChildCare, unsupported("Child care expenses (T778) aren't handled by this app yet"), 0)

T1.21200.label: Annual union, professional, or like dues

T1.22215.label: Deduction for CPP enhanced contributions on employment income
T1.22215.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the first enhancement (1% of 5.95%) and all second CPP contributions are deducted

T1.23300.label: Total deductions
T1.23300.formula: line.T1.20700 + line.T1.20800 + line.T1.20805 + line.T1.21200 + line.T1.22215 + line.SCOPE.deductions

T1.30000.label: Basic personal amount
T1.30000.formula:
round(param.basicPersonalAmountMax
  - (param.basicPersonalAmountMax - param.basicPersonalAmountMin)
  * clamp(line.T1.23600 - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart, 0, param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart)
  / (param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseEnd - param.basicPersonalAmountPhaseStart), 2)
T1.30000.source: Federal Worksheet, line 30000: the full amount up to the 26% bracket, going down to the minimum at the 33% bracket

T1.30100.label: Age amount
T1.30100.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.ageAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.ageAmountThreshold) * param.ageAmountRate, 2)), 0)
T1.30100.source: Federal Worksheet, line 30100: for people born in 1960 or earlier

T1.30300.label: Spouse or common-law partner amount
T1.30300.source: Schedule 5 line 30300: your basic personal amount minus their net income

T1.30400.label: Amount for an eligible dependant
T1.30400.source: Schedule 5 line 30400: for a single parent, one child under 18 who lived with you. The app assumes the child had no income

T1.30800.label: Base CPP contributions through employment
T1.30800.source: Schedule 8 for employees: the base part (4.95% of 5.95%) is a credit

T1.32600.label: Amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner
T1.32600.source: Schedule 2: their unused age amount and the tuition they designate to you

T1.33200.label: Allowable medical expenses
T1.33200.source: T1 lines 107 to 112: expenses over whichever is less, $2,834 or 3% of net income

T1.33800.label: Credit amounts at the credit rate

T1.34990.label: Top-up tax credit
T1.34990.source: Federal Worksheet, line 34990: keeps credit amounts above the first bracket at 15%

T1.40425.label: Federal dividend tax credit
T1.40425.source: Federal Worksheet, line 40425: the credit as shown on the slips

T1.42800.label: Provincial tax
T1.42800.formula: if(person.province == "ON", line.ON428.90, if(person.province == "BC", line.BC428.91, if(person.province == "AB", line.AB428.75, unsupported("Provincial tax for this province isn't handled by this app"))))

T1.44800.label: CPP overpayment
T1.44800.formula: if(sum(T4.box16) > param.cppEmployeeMax or sum(T4.box16A) > param.cpp2EmployeeMax, unsupported("More CPP was deducted than the 2025 maximum. The overpayment (Schedule 8) isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

T1.45000.label: Employment insurance overpayment
T1.45000.formula: if(sum(T4.box18) > param.eiPremiumMax, unsupported("More EI was deducted than the 2025 maximum. The overpayment isn't handled by this app yet"), 0)

S2.6.label: Their age amount and the tuition they designate to you

S2.7.label: Their taxable income, for the transfer

S2.11.label: Their basic personal amount, CPP, EI and employment amounts, and tuition
S2.11.source: Schedule 2 lines 8 to 11: their lines 30000, 96 and 32300

S2.13.label: Federal amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner

S3.13200.label: Gain or loss on publicly traded shares and mutual fund units
S3.13200.source: Schedule 3 line 4: proceeds (T5008 box 20) minus cost (box 21)

S3.19900.label: Taxable capital gains or net capital loss

S9.5.label: Total eligible amount of charitable donations
S9.5.source: Schedule 9 line 5: official receipts, and box 46 of T4 slips

S9.10.label: Donations claimed (within the limit)
S9.10.source: Schedule 9 lines 6 to 10: up to 75% of net income

S9.19.label: Taxable income in the top bracket

S11.8.label: Tuition fees for 2025
S11.8.source: Schedule 11 lines 1 to 8: eligible fees from T2202 box 26. The Canada training credit isn't claimed

S11.9.label: Unused federal tuition from your 2024 notice of assessment

S11.11.label: Income the tuition amount can reduce to zero tax
S11.11.source: Schedule 11 line 11: taxable income, or above $57,375, federal tax on taxable income ÷ 14.5%

S11.23.label: Tuition you can transfer
S11.23.source: Schedule 11 lines 21 to 23: this year's tuition up to $5,000, less what you used

S11.24.label: Tuition transferred to your spouse or common-law partner
S11.24.formula: if(line.HH.partner == 1 and household.partnerInYear and line.S11.8 > 0, min(answer.tuitionTransfer, line.S11.23), 0)
S11.24.source: Schedule 11 line 24: the amount you designate on your T2202, up to line 23

ON428.10.label: Ontario age amount
ON428.10.formula: if(person.age >= 65, max(0, param.onAgeAmountMax - round(max(0, line.T1.23600 - param.onAgeAmountThreshold) * param.onAgeAmountRate, 2)), 0)
ON428.10.source: Worksheet ON428, line 58080: for people born in 1960 or earlier

ON428.13.label: Ontario spouse or common-law partner amount

ON428.16.label: Ontario amount for an eligible dependant
ON428.16.source: ON428 lines 14 to 16. The app assumes the child had no income

ON428.24.label: CPP and EI credit amounts
ON428.24.source: ON428 lines 19 to 24: the federal amounts from lines 30800 and 31200

ON428.41.label: Allowable medical expenses
ON428.41.source: ON428 lines 36 to 41: expenses over whichever is less, $2,885 or 3% of net income

ON428.34.label: Ontario amounts transferred from your spouse or common-law partner
ON428.34.formula: if(line.HH.partner == 1 and household.partnerInYear, if(spouse.line.ON428.10 == 0, 0, if(spouse.person.province == "ON", line.ONS2.11, unsupported("Your spouse lives in another province: transferring their Ontario age amount isn't handled by this app"))), 0)
ON428.34.source: Schedule ON(S2): their unused Ontario age amount

ON428.44.label: Ontario credit amounts
ON428.44.formula: line.ON428.9 + line.ON428.10 + line.ON428.13 + line.ON428.16 + line.ON428.24 + line.ON428.34 + line.ON428.41

ON428.46.label: Ontario credit amounts at the credit rate

ON428.49.label: Ontario donations credit
ON428.49.source: ON428 lines 47 to 49: Schedule 9 lines 13 and 14 at 5.05% and 11.16%

ON428.68.label: Ontario surtax
ON428.68.formula: round(max(0, line.ON428.53 - param.onSurtaxThreshold1) * param.onSurtaxRate1, 2) + round(max(0, line.ON428.53 - param.onSurtaxThreshold2) * param.onSurtaxRate2, 2)
ON428.68.source: ON428 lines 63 to 68, on Ontario tax after credits (line 62)

ON428.73.label: Ontario tax after surtax and the dividend credit

ON428.75.label: Ontario tax reduction for dependent children
ON428.75.formula: if(line.HH.partner == 1 and line.HH.spouseNetIncome > line.T1.23600, 0, param.onTaxReductionChild * household.childrenUnder19)
ON428.75.source: ON428 line 75: $544 per child born in 2007 or later, claimed by the spouse with the higher net income

ON428.80.label: Ontario tax reduction
ON428.80.source: ON428 lines 74 to 80: twice the reductions, less Ontario tax

ON428.85.label: Low-income individuals and families tax (LIFT) credit
ON428.85.source: ON428-A Part A when single, Part B with a spouse or partner

ON428.86.label: Ontario tax after the LIFT credit

ON428.89.label: Ontario health premium
ON428.89.source: ON428 line 89 chart: $0 to $900 by taxable income, in steps at $20,000, $36,000, $48,000, $72,000 and $200,000

ON428A.5.label: LIFT credit before the income test

ON428A.13.label: Adjusted net income
ON428A.13.source: ON428-A lines 6 to 13: net income before it was floored at zero

ON428A.28.label: Your spouse's or partner's adjusted net income
ON428A.28.source: ON428-A line 28: from their return, or your answer for their net income

ON428A.38.label: Income over the LIFT thresholds
ON428A.38.formula: max(max(0, line.ON428A.13 - param.liftThreshold), max(0, line.ON428A.13 + line.ON428A.28 - param.liftFamilyThreshold))
ON428A.38.source: ON428-A Part B lines 30 to 38: the greater of your income over $32,500 and family income over $65,000

ON428A.41.label: LIFT credit, with a spouse or partner

ONS2.5.label: Their taxable income, for the transfer

ONS2.11.label: Ontario amounts transferred from your spouse

hasEmploymentIncome.help: A T4 from each employer you worked for in 2025.

hasInvestmentIncome.help: A T5 from each bank, credit union or broker that paid you $50 or more.

hasTrustIncome.help: A T3 from each mutual fund or trust held outside an RRSP or TFSA.

hasSoldInvestments.ask: Sold shares, bonds or fund units
hasSoldInvestments.help: A T5008 from each broker, for sales outside an RRSP or TFSA.

hasTuition.ask: Tuition at a college or university
hasTuition.help: A T2202 from each school, for 2025.

hasSelfEmployment.help: Income from your own business, freelancing or gig work (T2125).

hasRentalIncome.help: Rent from a property you own (T776).

hasPensionIncome.help: A workplace pension, RRIF withdrawals, Old Age Security or CPP benefits.

hasEiBenefits.help: EI regular, sickness, maternity or parental benefits (T4E).

hasForeignIncome.help: Foreign income, or foreign property that cost more than $100,000 in total (T1135).

soldProperty.ask: Sold your home or other real estate
soldProperty.help: The sale of a home, cottage or rental property (Schedule 3, T2091).

hasChildCare.help: Daycare, before- and after-school programs or day camps (T778).

rrspDeduction.help: Contributions from March 4, 2025 to March 2, 2026, up to your limit on last year's notice of assessment.

medicalExpenses.ask: Medical expenses you paid for yourself
medicalExpenses.help: Either spouse can claim the family's medical expenses; it usually saves more on the lower income.

donations.ask: Donations on official receipts (not on a T4)
donations.help: Either spouse can claim both spouses' donations; claiming them together usually saves more.

unusedTuition.ask: Unused federal tuition from your 2024 notice of assessment

tuitionTransfer.ask: Tuition to transfer to your spouse or partner
tuitionTransfer.help: Up to $5,000 of this year's tuition, as designated on the back of your T2202.

spouseNetIncome.ask: Your spouse's or partner's 2025 net income
spouseNetIncome.help: Line 23600 of their return. Their return isn't prepared here, but some of your credits depend on it.
